name: Crayon
medium: wax crayon on toothed paper: back-and-forth scribble fills that skip the valleys, a darker crayon on the shade side, a white one burnishing the highlight, a fat contour gone over twice
hero: a hot-air balloon

name: Cyanotype blueprint
medium: ruling pen and spring-bow compass in white ink on Prussian-blue cyanotype stock
hero: a watch movement's going train, plan and section A-A

name: Broken colour
medium: opaque oil dabs from a loaded flat hog brush on primed linen, unmixed colours side by side for the eye to mix
hero: a small harbour at sunrise

name: Charcoal, erased and redrawn
medium: vine and compressed charcoal on heavy rag paper, stumped, lifted with a kneaded eraser, redrawn over its own residue
hero: one oak through four seasons on one sheet

name: Coloured pencil
medium: wax coloured pencils hatched in one diagonal on toothy cream cartridge paper, hues layered, darks cross-hatched
hero: a wind-up tin robot mending a music box while a crow steals a screw

name: Hand embroidery
medium: stranded cotton floss stitched through natural plain-weave linen in a beech hoop
hero: a botanical wreath with a honeybee

name: Flat vector
medium: pen-tool paths in a vector app, flat fills that land when a path closes, long-shadow shapes with a transparency ramp, a raster grain brush over the shade sides
hero: a regatta of small sailboats on a bay under hills, the leader rounding the mark

name: Folk-tale storybook
medium: gouache and watercolour over an HB pencil drawing on cream cartridge: opaque, dry-brushed paint in the foreground thinning to a pale wash and then to bare pencil in the distance
hero: a boy carrying a rooster through a village kitchen garden at the edge of a birch wood

name: Cut-paper collage
medium: zero drawn lines: torn pieces with a white fibrous edge, scissor pieces crisp, each lifting a soft shadow off the piece below
hero: a fox at dusk

name: Newsprint halftone
medium: web-offset newspaper print: black on a 45 degree AM screen plus one orange spot at 15 degrees, oil ink gaining into unbleached groundwood newsprint
hero: a steam train crossing a stone viaduct at golden hour

name: Isometric cutaway
medium: flat vector planes on a true 2:1 isometric grid, three tones per material, crisp edges, pen-tool order
hero: a two-floor bakery cutaway at night, lit by its oven, the baker turning with a fresh loaf

name: Marker comic
medium: alcohol-marker cel fills with a hard shadow edge under one heavy contour that thickens away from the light
hero: a Sanke koi turning under lily pads

name: Risograph
medium: soy ink, one layer per drum multiplied through its own registration offset; every other colour an overprint, tone a halftone screen per ink angle, white is bare paper
hero: a lighthouse at sunset

name: Low-poly
medium: triangle meshes projected by hand through a pinhole camera, each facet flat-shaded by its normal against one low sun, painter-sorted far to near; no 3D engine
nearest: none (the only geometry plate); closest in spirit riso's flat inks
hero: A mountain lake at dawn: pink-lit range, spruce shores, a red canoe, reflections

name: Single-line engraving
medium: one unbroken engraved line whose width follows a procedural tone field: the whole picture is a single stroke
hero: a moon spiralled out of one line

name: Mid-century gouache
medium: opaque matte designer's gouache on warm illustration board, a dry brush dragged over the flats, a loose brush-and-ink line printed off register
hero: a hillside village where a girl flies a kite

name: Chalkboard
medium: side-of-the-chalk scumble on a slate board, lit limbs worked twice, every stroke broken by the board's tooth with dust either side, ghosts of old lessons
hero: the phases of the moon

name: Oil on canvas
medium: opaque oil paint with hog-bristle brushes on a toned linen canvas, lean block-in to fat impasto
hero: two pears and a copper pot by a window

name: Toy-theatre paper collage
medium: a cardboard toy theatre: patterned and sugar papers cut and torn, gouache-painted cut-outs with a white sticker margin, every piece with a card edge and a gap to the flat behind
hero: A seaside town on a toy-theatre stage: sea rows, harbour houses, a newspaper boat, a sun on a stick

name: Pixel art
medium: a 120x120 grid of cells, each one of 16 declared palette colours, laid one cell at a time and blown up by a whole number, no smoothing
hero: a cat mid-pounce after fireflies in a moonlit garden

name: Ballpoint sketch
medium: one blue ballpoint on cream cartridge, near-constant weight; tone only from where the hatching sits, plus the blob where a firm stroke stops
hero: a pocket watch lying on a table

name: Pencil & watercolour
medium: graphite and pan watercolour on cold-press: washes that never quite fill their outline, form shaded toward one light, graphite over the paint
hero: a ranunculus in bloom

name: Rubber hose
medium: India ink at one pressure on a clear cel over a blue-pencil rough, flat grey paint on the back, photographed and printed on black-and-white film
hero: a coffee pot mid-dance-step on a kitchen counter, steam curling

name: Archival scrapbook
medium: foxed rag-paper album page; torn cards, cellulose tape, a clothespin on twine; copperplate engravings hand-tinted; typewriter, ransom-note cut letters, red pen, rubber stamp
hero: How a honeybee finds flowers: the forager, the rose, the waggle dance, the evidence

name: Scratchboard
medium: white china clay under black India ink; every mark is ink scraped away with a knife or scratch nib
hero: a lynx, head and shoulders, in moonlight

name: Pen-and-ink stipple
medium: one 0.25 mm technical pen dotted straight down onto hot-press bristol; tone is dot density only
hero: a nautilus shell sawn in half, chambers lit from the upper left, cast shadow in dots

name: Storybook pencil + watercolour
medium: storybook graphite and gentle pan watercolour, drawn for a recurring character
hero: Bit, waving, in storybook pencil and watercolour

name: Sumi-e ink painting
medium: one loaded soft brush of sumi ink, five dilutions, on unsized absorbent xuan paper, with a cinnabar seal
hero: bamboo in wind with a tree sparrow

name: Toy brick
medium: moulded ABS toy bricks, rendered flat-plastic in orthographic view: face tones by the cube rule, bevel highlights, seam hairlines, real studs, a soft ground shadow
hero: a brick-built harbour tugboat on a baseplate

name: Ukiyo-e colour woodblock
medium: water-based pigment printed by baren from hand-carved cherry blocks onto damp kozo washi: a sumi keyblock, flat colour blocks, bokashi wipes
hero: two grey herons in rain on a wooden drum bridge

name: Ink & line-wash
medium: wet washes first that flood past the line and settle along each shape's bottom edge, backruns, then a flexible nib thick on the press and hair-thin on the lift
hero: a wren
